rationale: Justice Thomas is the assigning justice and has the highest-confidence, most text-centered rationale that can unify the five votes around a broad reading of § 2680(b) (“any claim arising out of” loss/miscarriage) without importing an intent limitation. Separate writings are most likely from the Chief Justice (a Dolan/contextual dissent) and from one of the textualist conservatives (Gorsuch or Alito) to emphasize anti–artful-pleading and strict sovereign-immunity principles.
